description: Thresholds for the Trace Eval page's decision guidance (vera/trace_eval/guidance.py). Every statement on the page is computed from the results and validation files with these values; none is a fixed conclusion.
dimensions_description: Groups of checks A1-A9 reported together on the page (vera/trace_eval/measure.py per_dimension). A check in no group is reported under its own name.
variant_descriptions_description: One public sentence per variant for the page's Context section (keyed by raw variant name; never shown raw).

variant_descriptions.baseline: a single call to a third-party hosted language model, with no search (historical capture shape)
variant_descriptions.grounded_v1: the historical search-grounded prompt: numbered abstracts and a cite-only rule
variant_descriptions.ask_api: VERA-DAR's live answer route, exactly as a user receives it (scope routing, retrieval and claim checks included)

case_sets_description: Rules that adapt an un-frozen question file to the check categories (vera/trace_eval/capture.py load_case_set). First matching rule wins; match values are case-insensitive substrings of the named field. Results from an adapted set are marked not validated: the blind labels in docs/trace_eval/ cover only the frozen set.
